name: Tachibana Hibiki
source:
Hibiki Tachibana is a character appearing in Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Mei in the Senki Zesshō Symphogear XD Unlimited collaboration event Warrior Princess March. She is a Symphogear wearer sent alongside Chris Yukine and Miku Kohinata to track down a missing artifact in the Higurashi world.

[From 07th Expansion Wikia]
